challenges.name: Give a Command to your World Pet
challenges.desc: Give your active pet a command from the Pet Command Wheel (Follow, Stay, Attack or Protect).

challenges.name: Have your Pet deal damage to an Enemy
challenges.desc: Damage from your active World Pet's own attacks (its bite or claws) counts. Damage you deal yourself doesn't.

challenges.name: Have your Pet kill an Enemy
challenges.desc: Your active World Pet's own attack (its bite or claws) has to land the killing blow. Your own kills don't count, even with your pet beside you. Any creature, critter or enemy NPC counts.

challenges.name: Heal your Pet
challenges.desc: Heal your active pet with a Stimpak when it is hurt or wounded.

challenges.desc: Your active World Pet's own attack (its bite or claws) has to land the killing blow. Your own kills don't count, even with your pet beside you. Only Cultists killed during The Mothman Equinox event count.
